v.why: Replacing a skip_connect on edge 4 with a conv gave +3 to +8 points on all datasets, far more than any other edge-4 edit.
Upgrading edge 3 from avg_pool gained +4.35/+5.42/+6.13 when edge 4 was skip_connect versus about +1/+2/+4 with a conv on edge 4.
With a weak skip on edge 2, replacing the edge 5 conv with avg_pool dropped -6.7/-11.9/-12.0 versus about -2/-3.5/-5.8 with a conv.
An avg_pool on edge 2 made the edge 5 avg_pool edit much more damaging (-6.1/-12.7/-12.7) than a conv on edge 2.
Edge 2 to skip_connect cost -2.6/-7.1/-4.7 when edge 4 was already skip_connect, versus roughly -0.3/-1.3/-0.4 with a conv.
Edge 1 to skip_connect lost -4.3/-9.3/-10.7 when edge 5 was skip_connect versus -1.2/-2.6/-1.8 with a conv on edge 5.
Removing edge 0 when edge 1 is also none cuts the main path and cost -6.4/-13.6/-16.1, far worse than when edge 1 has an op.
Removing edge 5 hurts much less (-0.9/-2.3/-3.6) when edge 3 is a strong 3x3 conv providing a direct alternative path.
Adding a 3x3 conv on edge 0 was harmful (-1.4/-4.4/-9.0) when edge 3 was none but mostly beneficial otherwise.
Edge 3 to 3x3 conv lost -2.3/-1.6/-2.9 with a 3x3 conv on edge 0 versus about -0.9/-0.2/+0.1 with a skip_connect there.

raw:
These ten hypotheses come from contrasts between matched parents in the 100 experiments. Each one rests on a few observations, so none is strongly established.

- **Edge 4 skip_connect:** replacing it with nor_conv_1x1 gained +3 to +8 points. Replacing edge 3's avg_pool with nor_conv_1x1 gained +4.35/+5.42/+6.13 with a skip parent, against about +1/+2/+4 otherwise. Edit 2→skip_connect lost -2.61/-7.14/-4.73 against about -0.3/-1.3/-0.4.
- **Edge 2 skip_connect or avg_pool:** changing edge 5 to avg_pool lost about -6/-12/-12 against about -2/-3.5/-6.
- **Edge 5 skip_connect:** changing edge 1 to skip_connect lost -4.32/-9.30/-10.70, against -1.15/-2.56/-1.80 when edge 5 is nor_conv_3x3.
- **Edge 1 none:** setting edge 0 to none lost -6.35/-13.58/-16.07, against about -1 to -4 otherwise.
- **Edge 3 nor_conv_3x3:** removing edge 5 hurt much less (-0.90/-2.32/-3.60) than with a skip parent (-4.12/-6.92/-9.60).
- **Edge 3 none:** changing edge 0 to nor_conv_3x3 is worse here (-1.38/-4.40/-8.97) than with other edge 3 operations (mostly positive).
- **Edge 0 nor_conv_3x3:** changing edge 3 to nor_conv_3x3 is worse (-2.28/-1.60/-2.90) than with a skip_connect edge 0 (-0.92/-0.16/+0.07).
